summary: FM Mattsson AB (publ) develops, manufactures, and sells water taps and related products for bathrooms and kitchens in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Iceland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, Germany, Belgium, Italy, and internationally. The company offers its products under the FM Mattsson, Mora Armatur, Damixa, Hotbath, and Aqualla brands. It sells its products directly and through wholesalers and retailers to property companies, the public sector, installers, stores, households, and commercial properties. The company was formerly known as FM Mattsson Mora Group AB (publ) and changed its name to FM Mattsson AB (publ) in June 2022. FM Mattsson AB (publ) was founded in 1865 and is headquartered in Mora, Sweden.
